Finish your film

Import videos from your computer, drag shots into order on the timeline, then export your finished video as an MP4.

Open video editor

No recorded takes required. In the editor, choose Import videos, create your film, and use Export MP4 when ready.

How to start the editor

From the TakeOne repository, run .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m takeone.editor.cli serve --media-root data/takes. In a second terminal, run cd apps/editor, then npm install and npm run dev.
